description: Get one of this shop's listings by id, in any status. Fails with `not_found` for another shop's or a deleted listing. Returns `listing`: `id`, `title`, `description`, `price` and `priceUnit`, `negotiable`, `status`, `verified`, `listingType`, `condition`, `location`, `district`, `city`, `images`, `video`, `category` (`slug`, `name`), `subcategorySlug`, `postedAt`, `views`, `contactCount` and `url`. Read it before update_listing to see the current values.

id.description: The listing to read: its id (such as `cmh0q2x8f0001...`), from list_listings or create_listing

name: get_listing

category.description: The category it is filed under

slug.description: The category slug, as create_listing takes it

city.description: Its city or province, e.g. "Hồ Chí Minh"

condition.description: The item's condition in words, e.g. "like new"; null when none was given

contactCount.description: Leads, all time: how many different signed-in buyers opened the seller's contact from it

description.description: The text on the listing page; an empty string when the seller wrote none

district.description: Its district or area; null when none was given

id.description: The listing id (such as `cmh0q2x8f0001...`); pass it to get_listing, update_listing, set_listing_status or delete_listing

images.description: Photo URLs in display order. To keep them through an edit, send this list back to update_listing

listingType.description: What the listing offers, e.g. "sell", "rent", "job" or "wanted"

location.description: The place as shown on the listing page, for display; use district and city to compare or filter listings

negotiable.description: Whether buyers may send offers below the price; always false for a job or a wanted ad

postedAt.description: When it was listed, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp

price.description: The asking price in Vietnamese đồng (VND); for a job, its monthly salary in VND. Show it with priceUnit, formatted as VND (e.g. 12.000.000 đ)

priceUnit.description: What the price is for, e.g. "VND" or "VND/month"; show it beside the price

status.description: active: on sale (public once verified). sold: kept on the site, marked sold. hidden: off the site but not deleted; set_listing_status moves a listing between these three. Any other value, such as expired or stale, means eno took the listing off the site

subcategorySlug.description: Its subcategory; null when it has none

title.description: The headline buyers see in search and on the listing page

url.description: Its page on eno; share it with buyers once the listing is public

verified.description: false while the listing waits for eno's check and is not public yet; true once eno has published it

video.description: The listing's video as a full URL; null when it has none

views.description: How many times its page has been viewed since it was listed, all time

listing.description: The listing as it stands now, including the title, text, price, district, condition and photos update_listing can change; null only if it was removed a moment ago

title: Get shop listing details
